The G-code simulator is built and passes all tests. Summary of what's in `/workspace/output/`:

**Files:**
- `CMakeLists.txt` — C++20 build using `cmake -B build && cmake --build build`
- `main.cpp` — CLI parsing, JSON serialization (output and trace), full state writer, delta writer
- `state.h` / `state.cpp` — MachineState definition with all modal groups, params, coord systems
- `parser.h` / `parser.cpp` — Block parser, expression evaluator (recursive descent with precedence), unary ops, parameter handling
- `interpreter.h` / `interpreter.cpp` — Executes blocks per Table 8 ordering, handles all G/M codes, motion sub-motion expansion, canned cycles G81–G89, arc geometry, probing, trace emission
- `tracer.h` / `tracer.cpp` — Trace recording (records full state snapshots; deltas computed at serialization)
- `io_files.h` / `io_files.cpp` — Tool table + parameter file I/O, UTF-8 BOM stripping
- `json.h` — Minimal JSON writer

**Coverage:**
- All CLI options: `--input`, `--output`, `--tool-table`, `--block-delete`, `--carousel-slots`, `--parameter-input/output`, `--probe-box`, `--probe-tool`, `--trace-output`, all three trace step modes
- G-codes: G0, G1, G2, G3, G4, G10, G17/G18/G19, G20/G21, G28/G30, G38.2 (probe), G40/G41/G42 (CRC: spec-correct for D0; simplified offset for D>0), G43/G49, G53, G54–G59.3, G61/G61.1/G64, G80–G89 (all canned cycles), G90/G91, G92/G92.1/G92.2/G92.3, G93/G94, G98/G99
- M-codes: M0/M1/M2/M30/M60, M3/M4/M5, M6, M7/M8/M9, M48/M49
- Expressions: all binary ops (+, -, *, /, **, MOD, AND, OR, XOR), all unary ops (SIN/COS/TAN/ASIN/ACOS/ATAN/ABS/SQRT/EXP/LN/FIX/FUP/ROUND), parameter substitution, nested `#`
- Percent demarcation, comments, MSG messages
- Trace delta encoding with `motion_kind` on canned cycle sub-motions, `nonmodal_g_codes` labels, sub-motion-cumulative time, error fields
- Clarifications: G41/G42 D0 (active with zero radius), G87 default I/J/K=0, G88 automatic retract

**Build:** `cd /workspace/output && cmake -B build && cmake
